outcome: lifetime fertility rate (live births per woman)
cohort: A convenience sample of 400 women aged 45-74 years who had completed their families and were interviewed in Erbil, Kurdistan Region of Iraq.
finding: Large family size is highly prevalent among women in Erbil and is significantly associated with age <18 years at marriage, short birth spacing, unplanned pregnancies, rural residency, and low socioeconomic status.
mod_finding: The Cesarean section (CS) rate was 7.3%, and 60.2% of births were delivered at home.
